text:
zoe: Quick copy + a11y check for the dashboard time-range quick-presets. Currently the presets read: "1h | 6h | 24h | 7d | 30d" as small buttons with tooltips that only show the label. PMs say users want clarity about alignment (data-end vs data-start).
patrick: Good point. We should clarify whether the preset is "last 1 hour" (relative to now) or "the previous calendar hour". Most users expect "last X" which is sliding window. Suggest copy: "Last 1 hour", "Last 6 hours", etc.
nana: tiny nit: avoid leading numerals-only labels for accessibility; screen readers announce "1h" poorly. Prefer full words in the accessible name but keep compact visual. So visually keep "1h" but aria-label="Last 1 hour (sliding window)".
patrick: Also add a tooltip body for edge cases: "Displays metrics for the last 1 hour, ending now. Use the calendar selector for fixed ranges." Keep it under 140 chars.
za: whoops typo, meant ana.
nana: Accessibility-bot: tooltip must be reachable by keyboard, have role=tooltip, and not rely on hover. Provide an aria-describedby that points to the tooltip content. For abbreviated visual labels, include aria-labels that expand them. Also ensure contrast on the button text >=4.5:1 in both light and dark themes.
zoe: For copy variants: 1) Compact visual: "1h" 2) Tooltip title: "Last 1 hour" 3) Tooltip body: "Data from now minus 1 hour to now (sliding window). For fixed ranges, use calendar."
patrick: For localization: the tooltip body should not include time words that reorder poorly. Use placeholders like "{amount} {unit} ending now" and let i18n handle grammar.
nana: Also add a small note when a query uses synthetic aggregation: "Values are approximate while aggregates are recomputing." But keep that in the advanced help link, not the tooltip.
a11y-bot: Checklist: buttons must be focusable, aria-pressed=false when inactive, role="button", aria-labels expand the abbreviated label, tooltips exposed on focus, and tooltip text <= 200 chars.
zoe: I'll update Figma with the compact visual labels + tooltip copy and add aria-label attributes in the component spec. Patrick, can you add the i18n keys: `timeRange.preset.compact`, `timeRange.preset.ariaLabel`, `timeRange.preset.tooltipTitle`, `timeRange.preset.tooltipBody`?
patrick: Yep. I'll also add a short example for each preset in the component docs (e.g., "Now - 1h").
nana: I'll run quick keyboard-only tests on the prototype once posted.
zoe: Thanks — posting update in ~20m. :sparkles:
